_comment: The tool-selection eval (D223): plain requests a person or an agent makes, each with the operation that should be chosen (op) and others that are also right (alt). find is scored on it by go test (internal/catalog, a gate) and metarush skills eval; metarush skills eval --live runs real Claude Code sessions with it. Every third case (the 3rd, 6th, ...) is held out: tune find on the others only. {project} and {clip} are a project's and a clip's name.
